qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Regulated French natural gas infrastructure (GRDF distribution and GRTgaz transmission) combined with hydro concessions form an irreplaceable toll-booth infrastructure network. Regulated asset base provides inflation indexing, supporting operating tangible ROIC of ~18-22%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance sheet leverage & interest coverage, REJECT). Core French utility with extensive regulated networks, but net debt of €25.5B is 6.9x net income (€3.69B) and total debt is €40.0B (10.9x NI). EBIT interest coverage of 3.45x falls well below the 5.0x fortress threshold, with volatile cash conversion due to working capital and heavy transition capex.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 net debt stood at €25.5B (€40.0B long-term debt against €14.5B cash) against net income of €3.69B. Interest expense of €2.58B against EBIT of €8.89B leaves interest coverage at 3.45x, failing Gate 6 balance sheet criteria. FY2025 OCF was negative (-€1.48B) due to working capital swings alongside €7.27B capex.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
